claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately captures the overarching requirement and all sub-provisions (A) through (D) for monitoring student progress under 20 U.S.C. 6312(b)(1).
The claim faithfully reflects paragraph (b)(2) regarding identifying and addressing teacher disparities.
The claim accurately captures paragraph (b)(3) concerning responsibilities under section 6311(d).
The claim accurately reflects paragraph (b)(4) regarding poverty criteria for selecting school attendance areas.
The claim correctly details paragraph (b)(5) on the nature of school programs and services for neglected or delinquent children.
The claim faithfully conveys paragraph (b)(6) regarding services to support homeless children and youths.
The claim accurately reflects paragraph (b)(7) requiring a strategy for parent and family engagement.
The claim captures paragraph (b)(8) and preserves its 'if applicable' condition regarding early childhood education coordination.
The claim fully preserves paragraph (b)(9) regarding identification of eligible children most in need in targeted assistance schools.
The claim accurately conveys paragraph (b)(10) and its sub-provisions (A) and (B) regarding middle-to-high school and high school-to-postsecondary transitions.
The claim faithfully represents paragraph (b)(11) concerning reducing overuse of exclusionary discipline and disaggregated subgroup tracking.
The claim correctly captures paragraph (b)(12) along with its 'if determined appropriate' condition and sub-elements (A) and (B).
The claim faithfully presents paragraph (b)(13) and discretionary examples (A) and (B) regarding gifted and talented students and school library programs.
